_help: Written by the weekly Claude scout (docs/weekly-scout-prompt.md). Same item format as opportunities.json, plus optional 'why', 'steps' and, for PhDs, 'research' (supervisors, publications, reading, angle). Top-level 'enrich' maps robot item ids to a research object.

items.title: LIDo BBSRC Doctoral Training Partnership: fully funded biosciences PhDs (2027 entry)
items.org: London Interdisciplinary Biosciences Consortium (LIDo), admissions via UCL
items.summary: London consortium offering about 26 four-year BBSRC studentships a year across DTP and iCASE routes, with a stipend at the UKRI London rate. Up to 7 places cover full overseas fees for international students; visa and relocation costs are not covered. Needs a first/high 2:1 or a relevant Master's and IELTS 7.0 (6.5 per part).
items.why: London-based, King's Institute of Pharmaceutical Science recruits PhD students through LIDo, and her Master's meets the entry bar.
steps: Today: browse the LIDo 2027 project list and shortlist rotations linked to drug delivery, pharmacology or antimicrobials (KCL/UCL groups)
Check the IELTS 7.0 requirement or whether her MSc counts as English evidence
Draft the personal statement around her pharmaceutics MSc and why interdisciplinary bioscience
Line up two referees now and ask them to submit early
Submit before 17:00 UK time on 1 Dec 2026

items.title: Cambridge BBSRC DTP PhD in Biological Sciences (Targeted and iCASE projects, 2027 entry)
items.summary: About 25 fully funded studentships (stipend about £21,805 plus fees). Up to 30% go to international candidates, and for them the student visa and health surcharge are also covered. Apply through the Cambridge Applicant Portal choosing up to two projects.
items.why: One of the few UK studentships that pays visa and IHS costs for international students; iCASE project ics27-san-ml1 is about drug action.
steps: Read the Targeted and iCASE project lists and pick two (e.g. ics27-san-ml1, extracellular vesicle assays for drug action)
Email the project supervisors with a short CV and one paragraph of interest this week
Write a statement of interest for each project and answer the short questions
Ask two referees to submit before 8 Dec 2026
Submit on the Applicant Portal by 8 Dec 2026

items.title: King's College London MRC DTP studentships (2027 entry)
items.summary: Fully funded MRC studentships (fees, stipend, bench fee) at King's; home, EU and international students can apply, with roughly 10 places a year shared by EU/international applicants. Overseas students pay their own visa and IHS. Stage 1 runs 11 to 27 Jan 2027.
items.why: King's pharmaceutical science is on her university list and uses the MRC DTP as a main funding route.
steps: Before Christmas: browse the 2027 project list when it is published and shortlist pharmacology/drug delivery projects
Contact one or two supervisors in December with a CV
Budget about £4,000 for visa plus IHS, since the DTP does not cover them
Submit Stage 1 between 11 Jan (13:00) and 27 Jan 2027 (13:00)

items.title: Nottingham BBSRC Doctoral Training Programme (2027 entry)
items.org: University of Nottingham / Nottingham Trent University
items.summary: Up to 30 four-year studentships covering fees and UKRI stipend. International applicants can apply (max 30% of the cohort) and successful ones get a scholarship covering the gap between home and international fees; visa and IHS not covered. Apply to one research cluster.
items.why: Nottingham is a strong pharmacy school on her list and the fee gap is covered for international winners.
steps: Pick the one research cluster closest to pharmaceutics/biotech
Apply on the Nottingham portal naming the BBSRC DTP as research topic
Complete the Microsoft Form with the application number
Deadline 12 noon UK time, 8 Dec 2026; interviews week of 1 Feb 2027

items.title: BBSRC North West Doctoral Programme in Bioscience (2027/28 entry)
items.summary: Four-year fully funded studentships (fees and UKRI stipend). Non-UK applicants can apply but full awards for international students are limited to exceptional candidates.
items.why: Manchester and Liverpool are on her list and both have drug delivery groups; international applicants are eligible.
steps: Check the NWDP project list for drug delivery, biotech or antimicrobial projects
Confirm English language evidence meets the requirement
Submit by 4 Dec 2026

items.title: Wessex One Health BBSRC Doctoral Landscape Award scholarships (infection biosciences, 2027)
items.org: University of Surrey, University of Sussex, University of Exeter and partner institutes
items.summary: Four-year scholarships in infection biosciences, including microbial evolution and drug resistance. Open to UK and international applicants (up to 30% international, with fees covered). Projects hosted at Dstl, UKHSA, APHA or Pirbright have UK residency rules, so pick university-hosted projects.
items.why: Antimicrobial/drug-resistance theme fits her biotech and pharmaceutics background, and international fees are covered.
steps: Filter the project list to university-hosted projects (avoid Dstl/UKHSA/APHA/Pirbright residency rules)
Shortlist projects on drug resistance or antimicrobials
Apply on the Wessex One Health form (not the Sussex form) by midday 11 Jan 2027

items.title: Yorkshire Bioscience DTP 2027, incl. 'A modular adhiron-VLP platform for targeted molecular delivery' (Huddersfield)
items.org: Yorkshire Bioscience DTP (University of Huddersfield project)
items.summary: BBSRC DTP open for 2027 entry via an expression of interest form; one listed project at Huddersfield builds virus-like particles for targeted delivery. A very limited number of international bursaries exist and they are extremely competitive; visa and IHS are not covered.
items.why: The VLP project is squarely targeted drug delivery, her core subject, though international places are very scarce.
steps: Confirm the expression of interest deadline on the DTP site (a secondary site says 6 Jan 2027; not verified)
Email the project supervisor at Huddersfield to ask about international eligibility
Submit the expression of interest naming this project
